card.title: Not That Subject
card.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't open that rent letter yet. Help me hang our new curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He'll love how we're looking after the place. Let's get a photo of the curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send him one and ask whether we're behind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with that carpet showing. Let's rearrange the room first. You move the sofa; I'll hold your phone.

mechanism: A keeps a rent-status conversation from happening by turning each route to the landlord into another decorating task.
confusable: Unlike mere procrastination, A must block the same specific subject as B changes how to reach it.
comparison: D14-b captures the phone through photo preparation; D14-a prevents a car inspection through a bus-and-breakfast plan.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
